verdict.rationale: The Marketing API documents generating and downloading a full account export, and a community user confirms exporting their subscriber list, so a first-party export path exists. However, the evidence never states which formats the export uses or whether it covers all data. One user reports that the browser inspector is the only clean way to move an email's HTML to another provider, which suggests campaign and template content is not fully portable. missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/HTML), confirmation the export covers all data types including templates and campaign content, hands-on corroboration of a complete migration out.
